prompts.prompt: Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: exploratory brand moodboard for Compor, a desktop creative workspace for independent course and mentoring creators preserving their own words. Create a beautifully composed landscape 3:2 art direction moodboard, full bleed ivory background. Direction: Oficina editorial. Restrained editorial confidence, warm white paper, deep navy ink, graphite, small vermilion editorial accents. Six varied regions with generous space, not identical cards: tactile closeup of letterpress registration on warm paper; a sophisticated lowercase wordmark 'compor' in a literary contemporary serif; three original tiny monochrome logo sketches using aligned sheets, open crop corners, and two voices meeting without erasing each other; a narrow vertical color strip; a macro typographic specimen with only the words 'sua voz'; and a crisp editorial poster composition with broad margins and a single blue rule. Flat printed work interspersed with photographed material, subtle soft daylight. One small heading exactly 'Oficina editorial'. No other words, no invented interface, no screenshots, no photographs of people, no sales or numbers, no mock customer evidence. Professional and approachable, not luxury cosmetics. Avoid AI stars, robots, rockets, brains, neon gradients, excessive decorations. Logo concepts are exploratory, not existing trademarks. Typography and layout legible, not a UI kit.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: exploratory brand moodboard for Compor, a desktop creative workspace for independent course and mentoring creators that helps them compose without losing authorship. Landscape 3:2 moodboard with bold, crisp modernist graphic design. Direction: Encaixe e composição. A deliberate palette of deep cobalt blue, buttery yellow, chalk white, ink black and a small terracotta accent. Distinct regions in an asymmetric but extremely orderly grid: flat geometric rectangles and quarter-circles precisely fitting together; large lowercase 'compor' in a warm geometric sans; three original monochrome logo explorations of two aligned modules making an open C in negative space, a hinged frame, and two distinct shapes composing one frame; color chips without labels; an enlarged geometric abstract poster with no text; a close-up physical blue and yellow paper construction with diffuse shadow. Main heading exactly 'Encaixe e composição', small specimen only 'cada parte conta'. Visual meaning: choices remain independent while joining a coherent whole. Energetic yet calm enough for an expert's daily work. No puzzle piece cliché, no childish blocks, no fake application screens, no logos of other companies, no claims, no stars or robots, no gradients. Shapes carry the board, not a decorative card grid. This must look markedly different from a neutral editorial paper board.

Use case: logo-brand. Asset type: exploratory art direction moodboard for Compor, a creative desktop workspace respecting the individual voice of a course or mentoring author. Landscape 3:2 composition with calm contemporary independent-publishing character. Direction: Caderno de autoria. Palette of deep aubergine, soft lavender, warm oat, clay pink, near-black ink. Unequal regions and intentional whitespace: elegantly curved bookmark in a folded cover; tactile close-up of woven book cloth and smooth tinted paper; confident lowercase wordmark 'compor' in a humanist sans with open forms; three original black logo sketches showing an open C as a folded page, two curved brackets enclosing space, and a single continuous ribbon with an intentional gap; a vertical color swatch set without codes; a large abstract rounded contour drawing with one visible pencil revision line. Main heading exactly 'Caderno de autoria'. Only other specimen text 'do seu jeito'. Sophisticated, warm, focused, authorial, not wellness, not a craft shop, not an app for children. No fake application screenshots or mockups, no photographs of people, no marketing claims, no AI sparkle, no robot, no brain. Restrict handmade texture to physical references; most layout clean and flat. Clearly different from both the geometric cobalt direction and navy editorial direction.
